# Box UI

Design tokens and icons generated from the Box UI Figma libraries. Every Figma
Variable mode — colour theme, accent, rounding density, typeface and device — is a
switch on an HTML attribute, and the whole alias chain re-resolves under it.

- Live documentation: https://egorovdnikita.github.io/box-ui
- Source: https://github.com/egorovdnikita/box-ui
- Licence: MIT (code), CC BY 4.0 (Solar icons, © 480 Design)

## Tokens

777 primitive values and 234 semantic tokens, emitted as CSS custom
properties prefixed `--box-`. A Figma alias becomes a `var()` hop, so nothing is
duplicated per theme.

```
npm i @box-ui/tokens
```

```js
import '@box-ui/tokens/css';        // primitives + every mode block
import { model, attributes, defaults } from '@box-ui/tokens';
```

### Switches

- `data-font`: inter | inter-display | inter-tight | inter-variable (default `inter`) — Figma collection “Typography”
- `data-radius`: low | medium | high (default `medium`) — Figma collection “Rounding”
- `data-accent`: blue | sky | teal | emerald | orange | amber | violet | purple | cyan | yellow (default `blue`) — Figma collection “Color”
- `data-theme`: light | dark (default `light`) — Figma collection “Mode”
- `data-device`: desktop | mobile (default `desktop`) — Figma collection “Grid”

Set all five on one element to resolve a whole theme locally; a custom property is
substituted where it is declared, so overriding one attribute deeper in the tree cannot
reach a token an ancestor already resolved.

### Collections

- `palette` — 584 variables, 1 mode(s), from “Color Palette”
- `spacing` — 29 variables, 1 mode(s), from “Spacing”
- `rounding` — 31 variables, 1 mode(s), from “Rounding”
- `size` — 29 variables, 1 mode(s), from “Size”
- `opacity` — 29 variables, 1 mode(s), from “Opacity”
- `type-scale` — 75 variables, 1 mode(s), from “Typography”
- `font` — 37 variables, 4 mode(s), from “Typography”
- `radius` — 11 variables, 3 mode(s), from “Rounding”
- `accent` — 43 variables, 10 mode(s), from “Color”
- `mode` — 70 variables, 2 mode(s), from “Mode”
- `grid` — 73 variables, 2 mode(s), from “Grid”

## Icons

1301 icons in 38 categories, in 6 styles
(Bold, Bold Duotone, Broken, Line Duotone, Linear, Outline). All 24×24, painted with
`currentColor`, sized with `size/base/*` tokens.

```jsx
import { Icon, IconStyleProvider } from '@box-ui/icons';

<IconStyleProvider style="bold-duotone">
  <Icon name="home-smile" size="l" title="Home" />
</IconStyleProvider>
```

Not every icon is drawn in every style — `catalog.icons[].styles` lists the ones that
are.

### Other families

- `flags` — 197 entries from the “Flags” Figma page, 197 with bundled artwork
- `payments` — 675 entries from the “Payments” Figma page, 541 with bundled artwork
- `brands` — 24 entries from the “Brands” Figma page, 21 with bundled artwork

- [Colours](https://egorovdnikita.github.io/box-ui/?path=/story/foundations-colors--palette): the palette, the accent modes, the semantic tokens in Light and Dark
- [Scales](https://egorovdnikita.github.io/box-ui/?path=/story/foundations-scales--spacing): spacing, rounding, sizes, opacity
- [Typography](https://egorovdnikita.github.io/box-ui/?path=/story/foundations-typography--ramp): the type ramp and the four typefaces
- [UI Icons](https://egorovdnikita.github.io/box-ui/?path=/story/icons-ui-icons--gallery): the searchable gallery
- [Figma families](https://egorovdnikita.github.io/box-ui/?path=/story/icons-figma-families--flags): flags, payments, brands
